method: Visible tab left open after baseline reload; no focus, navigation or reload on witness tab during publication; observation is an upper bound, not exact paint time.
limits: The commit log follows the commit; this interval is measured from that receipt, not from an independent database commit clock.
The baseline-to-observation interval also stays below 300 seconds and starts before publication.
This is an upper-bound observation on one changed archive scope, not exact paint timing or provider-to-browser latency.
